_comment: ModelArray GAM — NODDI ICVF dummy run (10 subjects, random-effect formula)
_formula_note: s(participant, bs='re'): random intercept per subject — far fewer parameters than fixed factor
participant must be numeric index for bs='re'; handled below via integer coding
group and sex as fixed factors
s(delta_age, by=group_F, k=3): group-specific time trajectory
formula: icvf_dwimap ~ s(delta_age, by=group_F, k=3) + group_F + sex_F + s(participant_idx, bs='re')
